name: tinygpu-trace-lab
description: An interactive 3D GPU architecture simulator for learning how GPUs execute instructions, move data, schedule threads, and process workloads.

scripts.build: npm --workspace simulator run build && npm --workspace web run build
scripts.validate:hardware: npm --workspace simulator run build && node scripts/validate-hardware.mjs
scripts.validate:kernel: npm --workspace simulator run build && node scripts/validate-kernel.mjs
scripts.validate:kernel:experiment: npm --workspace simulator run build && node scripts/validate-kernel.mjs --scheduler-reset
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace simulator run typecheck && npm --workspace web run typecheck
